response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during travel. Clause A4.1 covers the cost of medication prescribed by a doctor for an acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to excluded activities (e.g., alcohol, war, terrorism, or extreme sports—clause A11.3 is not applicable here as the injury occurred during normal walking)."}
